headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty extended gains following weekly rally as auto sales surge in October

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: Indian benchmark indices Nifty and Sensex rallied up to 2% across the preceding week.
Strong domestic and export figures drove impressive October sales numbers for major auto companies.
Buying in heavyweights like Reliance Industries and Adani Ports supported previous market upside.
Strength in IT and Pharma sectors lifted markets during recent trading sessions despite midcap weakness.
whatHappening: Tata Motors reported a 27% rise in October total sales, supported by passenger and commercial vehicle growth.
Eicher Motors' arm logged a 35% jump in October sales backed by robust domestic business.
Hyundai Motor India clocked its highest-ever total monthly sales in October.
Global beverage majors are advancing IPO plans in India from DRHP filings to board approvals.
summary: Indian equity markets are closed today for the weekend following a strong weekly performance where indices rallied up to 2%. Auto manufacturers posted impressive October sales numbers, highlighted by strong performances from Tata Motors, Eicher Motors, and Hyundai. Markets will reopen on Monday, 2 November, with investors watching whether bullish momentum continues.
